title: Fix map-authority mirror-sync self-block from always-on limit-watcher service
description: Fix map-authority mirror-sync self-block from always-on limit-watcher service: narrow active_local_writer_services()'s check for map-rns-watcher.service to actual recent writes (15s quiet window on its one overlapping mirror file, events.jsonl) instead of bare process-liveness, since the watcher is meant to run continuously and blanket-blocking on liveness alone permanently prevented mirror sync. Includes a TOCTOU-race follow-up fix (re-check immediately before the real file replace, inside the lock) found and required by independent review.
acceptance_criteria: active_local_writer_services() in MAP_System/scripts/map_authority.py no longer treats map-rns-watcher.service (limit_watcher.py, which only ever writes MAP_System/agents/limit-watcher-state.json, never map.db) as a disqualifying local writer -- confirm by reading limit_watcher.py's actual write targets before changing the check, not just assuming.

Root cause documented: map-rns-watcher.service restarted on Biggie at 2026-08-03T14:20:42-04:00 (systemctl --user show -p ActiveEnterTimestamp), and every map-authority-mirror.service run since has failed with 'local writer services must be disabled before mirror sync: map-rns-watcher.service' (journalctl --user -u map-authority-mirror.service), pinning graph/runner.py's route at STALE_AUTHORITY / review-only system-wide.

Fix preserves the original intent of the check (never let a second lifecycle-writing authority run on the Biggie mirror) -- if any doubt remains about what the check should actually be scoped to, consult TASK-310's design doc at MAP_System/artifacts/recovery/ws1-truthful-authority-state.md before narrowing it.

After the fix, map-authority-mirror.service completes a real sync cycle successfully while map-rns-watcher.service is still running (systemctl --user is-active map-rns-watcher.service reports active), and map_authority.py status / graph/runner.py route both report freshness OK, not INVALID.

Focused test added to MAP_System/tests/test_map_authority.py covering: writer-service list still blocks a genuine second-authority writer, but does not block map-rns-watcher.service. Independent core agent reviews the result before release, since this touches TASK-310's AUTHORITY-classified, trust-boundary-crossing contract code.
